name: Destined
source:
You wake up from a glamour to realize that you are about to be sacrificed by the High Lord of the Court of Flames. There is disruption, and a choice you must make. Who will you trust?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
